headline: Chuba Bucky Doo Wins by 1.2 as Long Live King Henry Benches Another 40-Point Game
meme_brief: A guy benches Jared Goff's 45-point outburst, loses by exactly 1.2 points, and it's the second week in a row someone in this league has sat a 40-plus scorer in a loss that size — the fantasy equivalent of leaving your wallet on the roof of the car and driving off.
recap:
Chuba Bucky Doo beat Long Live King Henry 128.4 to 127.2, the closest game of the week by a wide margin, and it happened because Jaxon Smith-Njigba went off for 43 points on Chuba Bucky Doo's side while Long Live King Henry had Jared Goff sitting on the bench with 45.05 points nobody used. That's the actual bench mistake here — Goff for Jalen Hurts, a swing of 18.25 points in a game decided by 1.2. Put Goff in and it's not close.  The biggest blowout belonged to Broke Dak Mountain, who ran over Pukachu Chews You 122.5 to 74.45, a 48.05-point margin, behind Josh Allen's 54.3 points — the single highest individual score in the league this week and, per the numbers, the actual league_top_scorer overall.

Dak to the Future kept its perfect record intact, beating Meredith's Fan Club 138.45 to 106.7 behind Dak Prescott's 44.55 points and CeeDee Lamb's 33.3, and still found a minor bench slip — Aaron Jones outscored Jameson Williams 10.5 to 4.3, a margin too small to change anything. Meredith's Fan Club, for its part, has now lived through back-to-back rough Sundays; Patrick Mahomes went for 41.8 but Puka Nacua scored zero points as a starter while Rachaad White sat idle with 11.3 unused.

Silverbacks lost to demon44 105.55 to 98.6 (actually 115.55 to 98.6) while sitting Bryce Young's 35.95 points in favor of Justin Herbert's 14.8 — a 21.15-point gift to nobody. And Screaming Eagles, now 0-2, benched Matthew Stafford's 43.25 points for Drake Maye's 11.1, a 32.15-point gap that's becoming the defining trait of that roster. Joe Mama Angie Daddy beat Screaming Eagles 133.55 to 113.1 while also sitting Travis Kelce's 21.6 points for Rhamondre Stevenson's 3.1, but the margin was wide enough it didn't matter.
transaction_desk:
Nothing this week cost anyone real draft-order capital — every move logged was an uncontested free-agent pickup, priority untouched across the board. The most sensible of the bunch was Pukachu Chews You adding Dylan Sampson as a direct backfield insurance play behind Quinshon Judkins, which is exactly the kind of depth add a last-place team should be making instead of chasing shiny names. demon44 kept doing what demon44 does — collecting free players (Kenyon Sadiq, Demarcus Robinson, the Packers defense) at zero cost and letting the roster fill in around the edges while sitting at 2-0.

The cumulative tracking is starting to tell some real stories. mikelanta's pickup of Jacoby Brissett has quietly produced 11.45 points in a single week off a free add, and the Las Vegas Raiders defense (also mikelanta) has racked up 16 points since being added for nothing. Meanwhile, Long Live King Henry's Week 1 grab of Devaughn Vele has produced 26.3 points since the add and still can't crack the starting lineup over the likes of Luther Burden. On the bust side, Joe Mama Angie Daddy's early-priority claim on Malik Davis has returned exactly zero points through two weeks — a burned priority slot with nothing to show, worth watching if it continues.

standings_narrative:
Through two weeks, Dak to the Future, demon44, and mikelanta hold the three division tops and would take seeds one through three, with mikelanta getting in at 1-1 purely on the strength of a stacked division. Chuba Bucky Doo and Long Live King Henry, both 1-1, currently occupy the next-best-record seeds four and five. The sixth and final spot goes not to the next-best record but to whoever has scored the most points outside that group, and right now that's Joe Mama Angie Daddy, edging out Waffle House for the points-based wildcard. Waffle House sits on the outside looking in, the definition of the bubble.

Silverbacks, Broke Dak Mountain, Screaming Eagles, Meredith's Fan Club, and Pukachu Chews You round out the field currently outside the picture, though it's only Week 2 — Broke Dak Mountain in particular has the look of a team that's better than its record given the closeness of its points-against total.
look_ahead: Next week, Chuba Bucky Doo faces Waffle House, Dak to the Future hosts the still-winless Screaming Eagles, and Meredith's Fan Club gets a shot at Joe Mama Angie Daddy after a rough two-week stretch. Long Live King Henry draws mikelanta, a potential trap game for a team still stinging from the Goff decision, while Broke Dak Mountain, fresh off the league's biggest blowout, takes on Silverbacks. Pukachu Chews You and demon44 close it out, a clear measuring-stick game between the league's last-place team and its undefeated one.
